doshas.label: Vata
doshas.description: You are driven by air and space energy. Vata types tend to be creative, quick-thinking, and adaptable, but may experience anxiety, dry skin, or irregular digestion when imbalanced.

doshas.label: Pitta
doshas.description: You are driven by fire and water energy. Pitta types tend to be ambitious, warm, and decisive, but may experience irritability, inflammation, or acid reflux when imbalanced.

doshas.label: Kapha
doshas.description: You are driven by earth and water energy. Kapha types tend to be calm, loyal, and grounded, but may experience lethargy, weight gain, or congestion when imbalanced.
